clues.it: Luca era nella 3ª colonna e nella 1ª riga.
clues.en: Luca was in the 3rd column and in the 1st row.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Fabio era accanto a un oblò e nel Criosonno.
clues.en: Fabio was beside a porthole and in the Cryo Bay.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 4ª riga e accanto a un fascio di cavi.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 4th row and beside a cable bundle.

clues.it: Nino era a nord di Paolo e in Laboratorio.
clues.en: Nino was north of Paolo and in the Lab.

clues.it: Dario era nella 8ª colonna e nella 6ª riga.
clues.en: Dario was in the 8th column and in the 6th row.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 7ª riga e accanto a un fascio di cavi.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 7th row and beside a cable bundle.

clues.it: Irene era nella 9ª colonna e nella 8ª riga.
clues.en: Irene was in the 9th column and in the 8th row.

clues.it: Ugo era l'unico seduto su una poltrona.
clues.en: Ugo was the only one sitting on a flight seat.

clues.it: Carla era nella stessa stanza di Sergio.
clues.en: Carla was in the same room as Sergio.

clues.it: Paolo non era accanto a una vasca idroponica.
clues.en: Paolo was not beside a hydroponic tank.

general_clues.it: 2 accanto a un fascio di cavi.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 3rd.

steps.it: Solo Fabio può stare nella 3ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 1ª è sua.
steps.en: Fabio is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 1st is theirs.

steps.en: Ugo's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 10th, column 2nd.
